tracks.name: conservative_qualification_with_explicit_uncertainty

tracks.guard: Exact clique lower among proven qualified/distinct; conservative upper among uncertainty-eligible with unknown edges permissive. No forced transitivity.

named_objection_risks.name: receipt_truth_boundary
named_objection_risks.risk: A forged parent FINAL receipt could satisfy schema without an actual call.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Require exact native handles/FINAL text/observer, immutable witness, preparation ledger and independent prelaunch; do not claim tool-level proof unavailable to this script.

named_objection_risks.name: semantic_method_visibility
named_objection_risks.risk: Operational prose may reveal which strategy produced a card.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Withhold administrative routing IDs and map; explicitly disclose partial rather than full semantic blinding.

named_objection_risks.name: largest_context_capacity_unverified
named_objection_risks.risk: A532-row result with small fixture bodies does not establish tolerance for up to16800 builder JSON words plus case/archive.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Freeze a narrower row-geometry capacity claim; record actual fixture/scored reviewer input sizes.

named_objection_risks.name: review_judgment_disagreement
named_objection_risks.risk: Independent reviewers can disagree or leave relations unknown.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Preserve both judgments and disagreements; require both for qualification; use conservative clique intervals without forced merge/transitivity.

named_objection_risks.name: malformed_excess_candidate_geometry
named_objection_risks.risk: An invalid builder can declare more than two cards; full raw coverage may exceed planned native capacity.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Preserve every declaration; mark structural invalidity, require exhaustive actual coverage and forbid superiority under protocol failure.

named_objection_risks.name: asynchronous_spawn_bookkeeping
named_objection_risks.risk: Legitimate worker output may precede started receipt.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Absent output at admission, record early first-save hash at start, require same hash and actualFINAL at join.

named_objection_risks.name: caps_do_not_equal_context_compute
named_objection_risks.risk: Main/residue branch lengths and processing cost differ.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Record exact normalized input/supplement words and actual saved output words; mark unmatched context; native token/cost null.

named_objection_risks.name: source_drift_and_hidden_glue
named_objection_risks.risk: Changed code/base prompt/case/rubric or undeclared source body contaminates inference.
named_objection_risks.mitigation: Frozen source hashes on ready/prompt/start/join/report; dynamic literal concatenation only fixed declared projections; no hidden runtime model adapter.

closure_checks.stage_fidelity: All14 arms share case/concerns; O/G controls retained; S05/S06 factorial remains separate from eight added stage1 interventions; S02 andS10 distinct

premortem.detector: Zero cards with nonempty no-opening reason validates
premortem.response: Count genuine zero opening as zero; never infer zero from missing output

premortem.response: Reject action; do not issue numeric superiority

premortem.detector: Started remains nonterminal regardless file existence
premortem.response: Do not fabricate FINAL or replacement call; parent must resolve real native status

premortem.failure: Literal input context exceeds what capacity fixture probed
premortem.response: Retain stated untested context ceiling and any actual reviewer failure
